Name: Hexness Bluegrass Fix for Flowergrass and Snowfields
Author: Hexnessie
Description:
[b][size=5]Changes[/size][/b]
[b][color=#f4cccc]Please see below for new installation instructions. [/color][/b]Unfortunately there's an installation step that has to be performed manually (I tried but could not find a way to do it any other way).

Also, Winter bluegrass sprites are now added.

Please let me know in comments if the new instructions work!

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I've been using Alvadea's Flowergrass and Snowfields mod for a long time even though it does not support bluegrass, because I just love the look of those flowery meadows so much. As the mod is based on More Grass framework, bluegrass cannot be natively supported. To fix it, it's necessary to move Flowergrass to a different framework called "Grass Variety" that works with newer grass types. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The bluegrass sprites may not be much to look at now, but at least they clearly show where the special grass is located. I will try to make the graphics better in future updates. Also, if you don't like the looks, you can easily replace the tilesheet with your own![/color]



[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Important Installation Instructions[/b][/size][/color]
(source: [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/GrassVariety/blob/main/docs/more-grass-shim.md]Grass Variety instructions on GitHub[/url])

[color=#f4cccc][size=4]1. UNINSTALL "More Grass", and install "Grass Variety" instead.  Install this fix mod now as well.[/size][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][size=4]2. Go to your game's Mods folder (...\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/size][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][size=4]3. Find a folder called "[MG] Flowergrass and Snowfields"[/size][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][size=4]4. In the folder, there is a [b]manifest.json[/b] file. Open this file in Notepad or another text editor[/size][/color]

[color=#f4cccc][size=4]EDIT THE LAST UNIQUEID LINE SO IT REDIRECTS TO [b]GRASS VARIETY:[/b][/size][/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53813/53813-1792940703-1175941082.png[/img]



[size=4][b]Creator's Notice[/b][/size]
[b][color=#ffff00][u]NO AI WAS USED IN THE CREATION OF THIS MOD.[/u][/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] The sprites are based on handpainted and slightly redesigned game resources created by Concerned Ape. If for some unfathomable reason you would like to use the sprites somewhere else, please let me know![/color]
